entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.code_description: Construction works for coastal and port constructions, dams, locks and related hydro-mechanical structures
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Services to combat soil erosion such as coastal and port construction works, dams, locks and other hydromechanical structures (for the case of water erosion); Flood defense services. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 42 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022, respectively in Order no. 157/2011.
